'''2009 Bespin Regionals Jake Nelson LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jake Nelson]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jake N
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
